t.eng-ummmuhammad: By the sky containing great stars
And [by] the promised Day
And [by] the witness and what is witnessed
Cursed were the companions of the trench
[Containing] the fire full of fuel
When they were sitting near it

ayahs.arabic: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.translit: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
ayahs.translit: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
ayahs.translit: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment
Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe
Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate
Honorable Owner of the Throne
Effecter of what He intends
Has there reached you the story of the soldiers
[Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud
But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial
While Allah encompasses them from behind
But this is an honored Qur'an
[Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate
